notes:
Zone (verified in the model). Ring faces N y 4.14, S y 0.49, W x −15.42; arms Y 1.27..3.34; lobby faces x −1.78 / +0.50. Door openings (scripts/probe_doors.py): Team Lead −14.05..−12.75, Hub Personnel −10.95..−9.85, Board Room −13.90..−12.85 and −17.60..−16.60, IoTec −11.00..−9.80, VIP Suite −17.65..−16.60, east arm −6.90..−5.85 / −7.70..−6.40; lobby: two doors on each side.

Photos. 160–170 and 191–196 show the ring and its arms. 154–157 show the lobby.

Built as new objects. 500 mm floor tiles; pale aqua walls and a deep teal end wall (“Dream big” poster, notices, a display case with a 3D printer); a ceiling with a foil coffer over the opening; glazed office fronts (white aluminium, frosted lower band, dark glass, louvres); doors closing every model opening; an open glass double door at the ring's east end; signs (VIP SUITE, TEAM LEAD, HUB PERSONNEL, BOARD ROOM, IoTec); posters; IoTec banners; a red chair; rusty concrete planters with plants at both ends of the void; railings and fascia round the void; fire alarm, CCTV, smoke detectors. Lobby: doors, office front, extinguishers, a fire-exit sign, the end window with a ladder and a plant. The ground floor below the opening has a bench and plants.

Differences from the photos. (1) The model corridors are about 0.8 m wide (about 1.5 m real), so the views are tighter. (2) Ceiling 2.51 m in the model against about 3 m real. (3) The rooms behind the office glass are not modelled (dark glass).
